### Scheduled Third Quarter 2026 Publication Date


10/02/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/986550758/files/doc_news/2026/Oct/Scheduled-3Q-2026-Results-Publication.pdf)


**Santiago, Chile, October 2, 2026** – LATAM Airlines Group S.A. (“LATAM” or “the Company”) (SSE: LTM / NYSE: LTM), together with its consolidated affiliates (“LATAM group”), the leading airline group in Latin America, announces that it will release its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on November 3, 2026, after market close. The results will be available on the Company’s Investor Relations website:[ir.latam.com](https://ir.latam.com/English/overview/default.aspx) .


The Company will hold a conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 financial results on November 4, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. ET / 10:00 a.m. Santiago Time.


In line with good corporate governance practices, the Company will begin its quiet period on October 20, 2026, ending immediately following the release of its financial results on November 3, 2026.


**Conference Call**


Wednesday, November 4, 2026


8:00 a.m. ET
10:00 a.m. Santiago Time
10:00 a.m. São Paulo Time
